answer: Each agent must stake jade tokens locked to a verifiable hardware attestation, recorded in a shared atlas mapping identities to devices. One concrete mechanism: bond-weighted identity anchored to a physical mesa of scarce compute. Creating a sybil requires acquiring new hardware and forfeiting jade on slashing, so attackers pay real capital per fake identity. Honest peers attest only consistent atlas entries, raising forgery cost above expected gain. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
